import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import AdaBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# 1. 导入数据
train_data_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_train.csv'
test_data_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_test.csv'

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_data_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_data_path)

# 2. 数据预处理
# 处理缺失值
train_df.fillna(train_df.mean(), inplace=True)
test_df.fillna(test_df.mean(), inplace=True)

# 将分类变量转换为数值变量
label_encoders = {}
for column in train_df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    train_df[column] = le.fit_transform(train_df[column])
    test_df[column] = le.transform(test_df[column])
    label_encoders[column] = le

# 3. 准备特征和目标变量
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=['G3'])
y_train = train_df['G3']
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=['G3'])
y_test = test_df['G3']

# 4. 构建 AdaBoost 回归模型
ada_reg = AdaBoostRegressor(random_state=42)

# 5. 训练模型
ada_reg.fit(X_train, y_train)

# 6. 评估模型
y_pred = ada_reg.predict(X_test)
mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
print(f"Mean Squared Error (MSE) on test set: {mse}")

生成的代码：
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import AdaBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# 1. 导入数据
train_data_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_train.csv'
test_data_path = r'E:\Postgraduate\Code\SunnylnAgent\data\csv\student_performance_test.csv'

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_data_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_data_path)

# 2. 数据预处理
# 处理数值类型的缺失值
numeric_columns = train_df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
train_df[numeric_columns] = train_df[numeric_columns].fillna(train_df[numeric_columns].mean())
test_df[numeric_columns] = test_df[numeric_columns].fillna(test_df[numeric_columns].mean())

# 处理非数值类型的缺失值
categorical_columns = train_df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
train_df[categorical_columns] = train_df[categorical_columns].fillna(train_df[categorical_columns].mode().iloc[0])
test_df[categorical_columns] = test_df[categorical_columns].fillna(test_df[categorical_columns].mode().iloc[0])

# 将分类变量转换为数值变量
label_encoders = {}
for column in categorical_columns:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    train_df[column] = le.fit_transform(train_df[column])
    test_df[column] = le.transform(test_df[column])
    label_encoders[column] = le

# 3. 准备特征和目标变量
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=['G3'])
y_train = train_df['G3']
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=['G3'])
y_test = test_df['G3']

# 4. 构建 AdaBoost 回归模型
ada_reg = AdaBoostRegressor(random_state=42)

# 5. 训练模型
ada_reg.fit(X_train, y_train)

# 6. 评估模型
y_pred = ada_reg.predict(X_test)
mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
print(f"Mean Squared Error (MSE) on test set: {mse}")
